_meta.description: Curated lookup: normalised organisation name → synthetic canonical_id for UK public bodies that lack a GB-COH registration. Used in ER Phase 2 (gov_lookup step). Each entry also carries a _source field documenting the evidence basis for the mapping.
_meta.warning: Entries here cause ALL GB-FTS IDs matching this normalised name to be merged into one canonical entity. Only add entries where the canonical identity is unambiguous. When in doubt, leave out and use the fuzzy candidate report instead.
_meta.status: DRAFT — verified against 2024 data sample (5,000 records). Requires review before treating as authoritative.

MINISTRY OF DEFENCE._source: 2024 data: 77 distinct GB-FTS IDs all bearing the name 'MINISTRY OF DEFENCE'. Single UK central government department (no CH number). Unambiguous.

UK RESEARCH AND INNOVATION._source: 2024 data: 18 distinct GB-FTS IDs. UKRI is a non-departmental public body established by Higher Education and Research Act 2017. No CH number.

NHS ENGLAND._source: 2024 data: 12 distinct GB-FTS IDs plus 1 GB-NHS-Y56. GOV-NHSE chosen as primary; GB-NHS-Y56 will be linked as alias in Phase 1 cross-ref. NHS England is a single statutory body.

SCOTTISH GOVERNMENT._source: 2024 data: 8 distinct GB-FTS IDs. Scottish Government is a single devolved administration. No CH number.

NATIONAL HIGHWAYS._source: 2024 data: 6 distinct GB-FTS IDs. Government company (formerly Highways England). Has CH number 09346363 but appears primarily as GB-FTS in data.

DEPARTMENT FOR INFRASTRUCTURE._source: 2024 data: 6 distinct GB-FTS IDs. Northern Ireland Executive department. No CH number.
